name: FELICITY
source:
Reyald is a very miserable wolf who feels alone and who has a bar that is not going very well. However, one of his virtues is that he is good at drawing and painting. His last painting, "Felicity", is the work of which he is most proud of, but he doesn't remember anything about it. He only know that, when he look at it, it brings him happiness.

[From [url=https://xptitloupx.itch.io/felicity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雷尔德是一只非常悲惨的狼，他感到孤独，而且他的酒吧经营得不太好。不过，他的优点之一就是擅长绘画。他的最后一幅画《幸福》是他最引以为傲的作品，但他对此什么都不记得了。他只知道，当他看到它的时候，它会给他带来快乐。

[来自[url=https://xptitloupx.itch.io/felicity]Itch.io[/url]]
